entries: From Latin Iordanēs, from Ancient Greek Ἰορδάνης (Iordánēs), from Biblical Hebrew יַרְדֵּן (yardén, “Jordan (river)”).
senses: Jordan (a river in West Asia in the Middle East, that empties into the Dead Sea, flowing through Israel, the Golan Heights, the West Bank and Jordan)
one of several brooks or small rivers in Germany

entries: Likely a calque of Russian Корейская Народно-Демократическая Республика (Korejskaja Narodno-Demokratičeskaja Respublika).
senses: Democratic People's Republic of Korea (official name of North Korea: a country in East Asia)

entries: Borrowed from Latin methodus f, from Ancient Greek μέθοδος (méthodos).
senses: method (process by which a task is completed)
method (subroutine or function in object-oriented languages)

entries: From Spanish moái, from Rapa Nui mo'ai (“statue, figurine”).

senses: strong/mixed nominative/accusative neuter singular of mystisch

entries: From Middle High German swil, from Old High German swil, from Proto-West Germanic *swili, from Proto-Germanic *swiliz, related to German schwellen.

senses: strong/mixed nominative/accusative neuter singular of vereinbar
